name: local-conversation-history
description: >- Entry point for local AI conversation history across providers. Routes a request to the one skill that owns it, by platform (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Kimi CLI) and action (read evidence vs continue interrupted work), and owns the one job none of them own alone: a single inventory spanning all three providers. author: daymade
summary_zh: 统一管理 Claude Code、OpenAI Codex 和 Kimi CLI 的本地对话记录，适合跨平台查找历史、了解近期工作或继续中断的任务。
